title: 09-24 upload K3F-KD3
description: Packed 3-member ensemble of sim-pretrained b5 SimVP backbones (each a uniform soup of 4 fine-tunes), run in fp16; CB centre blend with per-trajectory weight (AW); per-trajectory width multiplier and energy-blend weight (AX, grid 0.75-0.925); gain clip 20; exact scored mask; KD2 / KD3 kernel diets.
